note: An old log landing beside Laurel Run Road, a gravel forest road, 0.3 mile north of Middle Ridge Trail: a clearing about 15 m by 10 m in full sun on a 60-ft gravel driveway. Pull-in only. The booking page grades the site itself 'Moderate', so expect to level. The agency's own campsite layer marks it as not trailer-accessible, though the booking page lists it for trailers up to 25 ft. Picnic table and stone fire ring. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Keep. Site is live and bookable online (all nights tried open), 25 ft max vehicle length, $10 resident / $15 non-resident plus $6.50. Added reservation fee, booking note, pull_through false, facilities; note rewritten. Phone should be the district office.
